newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: ATI says expands berthing area.
newsitem.headline: ATI says expands berthing area.

text.p: Asian Terminals Inc said on Friday its container ship capability at the Manila South Harbor had increased with the opening of 256 meters of new berth space.

The new berth extension at ATI's Pier 5 had raised the firm's total container quayline in the area to 1,356 meters from the present 1,100 meters, the firm said in a statement to the Philippine Stock Exchange.
The additional quay length will accomodate three container vessels, with a length of 150 meters each, making simultaneous port calls at Pier 5 from the previous two ships, a company official said.
The firm will also acquire a new ship-to-shore crane middle of this year to speed-up unloading of container cargoes.
